name: Security Consolidation & Simplification Intent
description: Signals indicating a company's desire to reduce security tool sprawl, unify platforms, and streamline management for operational efficiency and consistent policy enforcement.

name: Advanced Browser Security & Attack Surface Reduction Intent
description: Signals pointing to an organization's concern about browser-specific vulnerabilities, the need for stronger browser-level controls, and proactive measures against browser-borne threats.

name: Hybrid Workforce & Remote Access Security Modernization Intent
description: Signals reflecting challenges in securing diverse browser environments and corporate resources for a distributed or hybrid workforce, emphasizing productivity and secure access.

name: Data Protection & Compliance Enhancement Intent
description: Signals related to efforts to prevent data exfiltration, enforce data loss prevention (DLP) policies, and ensure regulatory compliance, particularly concerning data accessed via browsers.

name: Threat Adaptation & Comprehensive Visibility Intent
description: Signals indicating a struggle to keep pace with evolving cyber threats, a lack of holistic security visibility, and the need for more adaptive and integrated security strategies.

name: SaaS & Cloud Application Security Intent
description: Signals demonstrating a need for robust security measures specifically for SaaS applications and internet access, driven by widespread adoption and associated risks.
